newsitem.title: USA: Dominick's plans nine stores for FY97.
newsitem.headline: Dominick's plans nine stores for FY97.

text.p: Dominick's Supermarkets Inc president Robert Mariano said the company's fiscal 1997 plans to build nine new Dominick's Fresh Stores are well underway. Mariano said four new stores are currently under construction.
The company, which operated 100 stores under the Dominick's and Omni names in fiscal 1996, went public in late October. Eight new Dominick's Fresh Stores opened in fiscal 1996.

It reported a loss for the fourth quarter ended November 2 of $10.1 million or $0.82 per share. Results reflect payment of preferred dividends. The quarter also included IPO charges and a loss on early retirement of debt.
Fourth-quarter sales rose to $611.4 million from $544.6 million a year earlier.

"Our margins improved as we began to realize the benefits of our ongoing initiatives to reduce costs and improve productivity," Mariano said in a statement. "With our initial public offering successfully completed, we're starting fiscal 1997 with significantly lower interest costs and enhanced financial flexibility."
